data/route_enemy_runtime.json.scope: Existing stage factors and Boss-placeholder attacks preserved; approved non-Boss health/pattern/body overrides live in route_nonboss_runtime.json.

north_spawn.description: Only the north portal forecourt; locked exit illumination is decorative, not an active spawn hazard.

data/route_enemy_runtime.json.stage_rules: Only health, walking speed, projectile speed and attack-cycle start intervals change by room. Damage, footprints, attack shapes, direction locking and warnings stay fixed. Minimum cycle includes the full readable attack and recovery.

body_contact.multiple_bodies: highest final eligible damage wins; stable actor id breaks ties
body_contact.damage_bucket: direct; normal defense/shield; no projectile-only reduction

health_budget.existing_role_reference: actual current room health before proposed multiplier, including current stage; never multiply twice
health_budget.new_roles_reference: M05 reads same-room M02; M06/M07 read same-room M04

data/route_nonboss_runtime.json.scope: Approved non-Boss design21, explicitly authorized for implementation. Boss placeholders excluded. No runtime dependency on tools/balance.

aimed.aim: relock before each shot; straight after release

fan.aim: lock fan center at warning start

ring.aim: first gap faces locked player; following gaps turn 30 degrees, shown before release

sweep.aim: lock sweep center; alternate fixed left-to-right and right-to-left; no tracking

data/route_boss_runtime.json.source_design: docs/游戏设计/22-四个Boss与必金双奖励方案.md

data/first_room_runtime.json.scope: current first playable room geometry plus missing movement and collision rules; historical shared layout candidates remain unchanged, as do approved base, spell, economy and meta values

data/courtyard_route.json.encounter_scope: 56 approved non-Boss encounters (929 enemies), seven normal roles and existing elites; four legacy elite Boss placeholders unchanged (69 enemies). 998 total. Rewards and shops unchanged; formal Boss behavior and dual rewards deferred.
data/courtyard_route.json.coordinates: meters; x right; z toward upper portal; origin at room center
data/courtyard_route.json.selection: cycle templates by authored legacy layout occurrence, excluding first room

encounter_limits.description: Legacy limits retained for Boss placeholders. Non-Boss limits and role caps come from route_nonboss_runtime.json. Whole packs wait without wave shield or cooldown resets.

difficulty_bands.name: 前期
difficulty_bands.description: 追击与直射起步，学习扇射和身体接触，逐步加入冲锋。

difficulty_bands.name: 中期
difficulty_bands.description: 扇射、缺口环弹与冲锋混编，落印要求持续换位。

difficulty_bands.name: 后期
difficulty_bands.description: 加入旋转扫射，交叉火力与精英接力检验成型构筑。
